section_summary.extract_value: This section investigates the relationship between ethnic identity and body appreciation, self-esteem, appearance evaluation, Western beauty ideal internalization, and eating disorder pathology. It details a mediation analysis using 5,000 bootstrapped resamples to test the mediating role of Western beauty ideal internalization. The analysis found that Western beauty ideal internalization mediated the relation between ethnic identity and eating, shape, and weight concerns, but not body appreciation.
